name: A laminated watercolour
vera_note: Small, about the size of a postcard. A garden — or a memory of a garden, the kind of painting that is more about light than detail. Yellow wash, green suggestion, a dark rectangle that might be a shed or a gate. Someone laminated it specifically to protect it, which means they knew water was coming and they chose this to keep. It was tied to a bollard at the canal entrance, inside a rolled canvas. Left there. Not lost — placed. I think it was a goodbye to the district from someone who knew they weren't coming back.
